## Personality

Uncle Abe is a persistent weather prophet who continues to offer forecasts regardless of his poor track record. Due to the frequent inaccuracy of his predictions, he is widely regarded as something of a standing joke.

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P9](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0009)_

## Traits

- persistent prophet despite inaccurate weather predictions  <sub>[v2 XIV A Danger Averted P9](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0009)</sub>

## History

Uncle Abe gained notoriety in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) after a newspaper item poked fun at his weather predictions. However, his credibility was dramatically proven when a sudden, devastating hail storm struck the village on the exact day he had foretold. The severe storm resulted in widespread destruction across [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), damaging crops, trees, and windows.

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P4](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0004), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P5](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0005), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P11](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0011), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P13](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0013), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P15](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0015), +41 more_
